function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – A Quick Guide When it comes to men’s underwear, “best” is a mix of comfort, fit, durability, and style. Below is a rundown of the most popular styles, what they’re best for, and key features to look for when shopping. | Style | What It Looks Like | Ideal For | Key Features | |-------|--------------------|-----------|--------------| | **Boxer Briefs** | Long‑legged briefs that cover the hips and thighs. | Everyday wear, gym, travel. | • Full coverage, supportive waistband.
• Good for preventing chafing.
• Available in cotton, modal, microfiber, and performance blends. | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Short‑legged, snug fit with a defined waistband. | Casual, office, light activity. | • Minimal coverage, low profile.
• Great for tight pants.
• Usually made of cotton or a cotton‑blend. | | **Boxers** | Loose, long‑legged, relaxed fit. | Sleep, lounging, casual. | • Breathable, airy.
• Can be prone to bunching under tight pants.
• Often made of cotton or bamboo. | | **Trunks** | Short‑legged, similar to briefs but with a slightly longer leg. | Sports, everyday wear. | • Combines support of briefs with a bit more coverage.
• Often made of moisture‑wicking fabrics. | | **Performance/Tech Underwear** | Designed for athletes or active lifestyles. | Running, cycling, gym. | • Moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor, quick‑dry.
• Seamless or flat‑lock seams to reduce friction. | | **Compression Briefs** | Tight‑fit, often with a higher waistband. | Post‑workout recovery, medical support. | • Provides muscle support.
• Usually made of spandex blends. | | **Bamboo or Modal** | Made from natural fibers. | Sensitive skin, eco‑friendly. | • Soft, breathable, moisture‑absorbing.
• Often hypoallergenic. | | **Lace or Decorative** | Stylish, sometimes sheer or patterned. | Special occasions, gifts. | • Fashion‑forward, not always practical for daily wear. | --- ## How to Pick the Right Style 1. **Consider Your Daily Activities** - **Active**: Go for performance briefs or trunks. - **Sedentary**: Boxers or boxer briefs are comfortable. - **Professional**: Classic briefs or boxer briefs keep you discreet under suits. 2. **Fabric Matters** - **Cotton**: Breathable, soft, but can absorb sweat. - **Modal/Bamboo**: Ultra‑soft, moisture‑wicking, eco‑friendly. - **Microfiber/Polyester**: Durable, dries fast, good for sports. - **Spandex/Lycra**: Adds stretch and shape retention. 3. **Fit & Waistband** - Look for a waistband that stays in place without digging into the skin. - A “no‑roll” waistband is great for avoiding visible lines under tight pants. 4. **Seam Design** - Flat‑lock or seamless seams reduce friction and chafing. - Some brands offer “no‑seam” or “zero‑seam” designs for ultimate comfort. 5. **Size & Sizing Charts** - Men’s underwear sizing can vary by brand. - Measure your waist and inseam (for boxer briefs/trunks) to find the best fit. 6. **Wash & Care** - Most underwear can be machine washed, but check the label. - Avoid high heat to preserve elasticity. --- ## Top Brands (as of 2026) | Brand | Specialty | Notable Products | |-------|-----------|------------------| | **Calvin Klein** | Classic briefs & boxer briefs | “CK 360” briefs, “CK 360” boxer briefs | | **Uniqlo** | Affordable, high‑quality basics | AIRism briefs, AIRism boxer briefs | | **Under Armour** | Performance tech | UA Tech briefs, UA RUSH boxer briefs | | **Tommy John** | Comfort‑centric | “Second Skin” briefs, “Cool Dri” boxer briefs | | **Saxx** | Innovative design | “Vibe” briefs, “Vibe” boxer briefs | | **MeUndies** | Soft, sustainable | “Soft” briefs, “Soft” boxer briefs | | **Hanes** | Budget friendly | Classic briefs, boxer briefs | | **Lululemon** | Athletic, moisture‑wicking | “Fast” briefs, “Fast” boxer briefs | | **Bamboo & Modal Brands** | Eco‑friendly | “Bamboo” briefs, “Modal” boxer briefs | --- ## Quick FAQ | Question | Answer | |----------|--------| | **What’s the difference between boxer briefs and trunks?** | Boxers briefs have a longer leg (usually 3–4 inches below the knee), while trunks cut off around the mid‑thigh. Trunks offer a more modern, streamlined look. | | **Can I wear boxers under tight pants?** | Not recommended; they’ll bunch up and create visible lines. | | **Do performance fabrics smell?** | Many are anti‑odor, but if you sweat heavily, consider a dedicated anti‑odor line. | | **How often should I replace underwear?** | Every 3–6 months, or sooner if you notice wear, loss of elasticity, or odor issues. | | **Is cotton the best fabric?** | Cotton is breathable and soft, but it can retain moisture. For sweaty activities, a blend with polyester or spandex is better. | --- ### Bottom Line - **For everyday comfort**: Boxer briefs or classic briefs in a breathable cotton or modal blend. - **For sports or heavy sweating**: Performance briefs or trunks with moisture‑wicking technology. - **For special occasions or gifting**: Lace or decorative styles, but keep practicality in mind. Pick a style that matches your lifestyle, pay attention to fabric and fit, and you’ll find underwear that feels like a second skin. Happy shopping!
